title: Understand the Status-LED
goal: Interpret the Pro-finder Status-LED correctly and identify the device operating state.
prerequisites: The Pro-finder is installed and connected to its power supply.
You can see the Status-LED or have another person describe its colour and flashing pattern.

steps.text: Observe the Status-LED for several seconds: is it continuously lit or flashing, and which colour or colour combination does it show?
Use the following overview to match the observed pattern to one of the nine operating states.

expected_result: After installation and programming are complete, the Status-LED flashes green during normal operation (state 9: registered, reception available and destination numbers saved).

error_cases.correction: The SIM card is missing or defective (state 4). Check that a working Nano-SIM is inserted correctly; see the task “Prepare and insert the SIM card”.

error_cases.problem: The Status-LED flashes alternately red and green.
error_cases.correction: The SIM-card PIN has not been disabled (state 5). Disable the SIM PIN request; the quick-start guide states that this is mandatory.

figures.alt: Nine Status-LED pattern bars, one for each state, using red, yellow, green or colour combinations.
figures.long_description: For each of the nine operating states, the quick-start guide shows a horizontal bar representing the LED pattern in colour, for example alternating red and yellow segments for red/yellow flashing. The bars encode information only through colour and rhythm. The table in this task gives the complete meaning of every state as text.
steps_text: Each bar represents one numbered state from 1 to 9.
The bar colour or colours correspond to the LED colour; the segmentation represents the flashing pattern.
The overview table in this task states the full meaning in text.

tables_md:
| No. | Status-LED pattern | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Flashes red/yellow | Searching for a network and no destination numbers saved |
| 2 | Flashes red | Searching for a network or no GSM reception |
| 3 | Continuously yellow | Establishing a connection to the modem |
| 4 | Continuously red | SIM card missing or defective |
| 5 | Flashes red/green | SIM-card PIN not disabled |
| 6 | Flashes yellow | Registered, but the last SMS could not be sent |
| 7 | Continuously green | Pro-finder is receiving or sending an SMS |
| 8 | Flashes green/yellow | Registered with reception, but no destination numbers saved |
| 9 | Flashes green | Registered with reception and destination numbers saved |
